en: A monochrome, illustrated riverside scene showing a paddle-wheel steamship with two smoking funnels towing barges along a broad river. On the opposite bank, a town with clustered houses rises on a hill, dominated by a large church or cathedral with a tall nave and tower as well as several other steeples. Sailing vessels are moored near the nearer bank, and trees frame the foreground. The style resembles a late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century engraved or lithographed postcard.
